subject.title: Scope workspace guidance to coding contexts

question: Should maintainers replace this broad stale branch with a narrow prompt-only branch, or explicitly sponsor a full embedded-runner rewrite that repairs the auth, replay, config, and prompt-safety regressions first?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and compatibility/security-sensitive runtime changes require human ownership of whether to salvage the prompt policy idea or abandon this branch shape.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Prompt Patch
options.body: Recreate only the workspace-guidance scoping on current main and keep embedded-runner stream, auth, replay, and cache-boundary code unchanged unless separately justified.

options.title: Repair This Branch First
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, restore every existing prompt/config/auth/replay contract, add focused regression tests, and then provide real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Sponsor The Runtime Rewrite
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the broad rewrite direction, but should own the upgrade and security proof burden before landing it.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Prompt Patch
recommendation.body: Recreate only the workspace-guidance scoping on current main and keep embedded-runner stream, auth, replay, and cache-boundary code unchanged unless separately justified.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete most strongly to the agent-runtime, prompt, and auth-boundary paths this PR rewrites.
